name: Sasebo City
description: Port city in Nagasaki Prefecture and gateway to the Kujukushima islands. Home to Huis Ten Bosch theme park, Kujukushima Pearl Sea Resort, and a historic naval port. Famous for Sasebo burgers and maritime culture.
